Table 2.2: List of Principal Uses Allowed by Zoning District
P Use is Allowed by Right in the District Indicated
● Use is Allowed with Restrictions (see Section indicated)
S Use Requires Special Use Approval
B Use is Permitted only if allowed by base district
* Use is Permitted as Office Only
Use is Permitted if Proposed within Existing Structure with No Expansion;
**
Otherwise, Special Use Permit Required
Use is not Allowed if no symbol appears
